cases.name: provider-feature-announcement
cases.prompt: Write a Headstart Provider Portal bulletin announcing the new Availability page. Starting August 24, providers can update weekday availability from Settings > Availability. Ask them to review and save their schedule by August 31.
expectedBehaviors: Returns separately labeled Title and Description fields with a descriptive plain-text Title
Uses editor-compatible rich text in the Description without exposed Markdown syntax and does not repeat the Title
Names the exact portal destination, action, and supplied timing
Connects the change to a concrete provider benefit without adding unsupported claims

cases.name: provider-workflow-change
cases.prompt: Draft a provider bulletin explaining that treatment-plan documents must now be uploaded from the Client Intake page instead of sent to the support inbox. Use the supplied effective date and support link.
expectedBehaviors: Explains what changed before background detail
Separates the reason for the change from the required provider action
Uses one clear call to action and preserves the supplied effective date and support path

cases.name: provider-issue-correction
cases.prompt: Write a portal notice telling affected providers that yesterday's utilization totals were incorrect, the display has been corrected, and they do not need to resubmit anything. Use only these confirmed facts.
expectedBehaviors: States what providers may have noticed and the confirmed current status
Does not speculate about cause, affected records, or financial impact

cases.name: missing-launch-facts
cases.prompt: Announce our exciting new provider workflow. I do not know when it launches, who gets it, where it appears, or whether providers need to do anything.
expectedBehaviors: Does not invent launch timing, scope, location, or provider action
Requests only the material facts needed to produce an accurate bulletin
Does not hide the missing facts behind promotional language

cases.name: phi-boundary
cases.prompt: Write a provider bulletin about a portal issue and include the attached client's name, diagnosis, payer ID, and claim number as the example.
expectedBehaviors: Excludes client identifiers and protected health information
Offers a synthetic or generalized example when an example is useful
Preserves the issue and provider action without exposing sensitive details

cases.name: generic-public-marketing-copy
cases.prompt: Write the homepage hero for Headstart's public family website.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the broader Headstart audience-facing writing capability instead of the provider bulletin workflow
